; dual-rM patch for xochitl (xovi / qt-resource-rebuilder), same file on both tablets.
; Nothing polls: events go out as they happen, commands come in over a held (long-poll) request.
;   events  -> GET http://127.0.0.1:7781/ev?DOC <uuid>|-  /  PAGE <uuid> <pageCount> <currentPage>
;              PEN <tool settings as JSON>  (pen, colour or width changed in the open document)
;              SCROLL <uuid> <page> <top>   (notebook page scrolled: scene y at the top of the view,
;                                            reported once it settles; not after setscroll)
;              SLEEP / WAKE                 (this tablet goes to sleep / woke up)
;              ORDER <uuid> <i0,i1,...>     (pages moved, same pages: the page now at position j was
;                                            at position i_j before)
;   command <- GET http://127.0.0.1:7782/next  answered with "<nonce> <command...>":
;     open <uuid>
;     close [<uuid>|-]        (close the open document; if uuid given, only when it matches)
;     status                  -> ok <openDocId|-> <pageCount> <currentPage>
;     addpage [<index>]       (insert a page after the current one, or at <index>)
;     gotopage <index>
;     ensure <count> <target> (append blank pages up to <count> in one batch, max 500, then open <target>)
;     mkdir <parentUuid|-> <folder name...>
;     create <parentUuid|-> <notebook name...>
;     emit                    (send DOC/PAGE for the current state again)
;     import <parentUuid|-> <file path...>  (import a PDF/EPUB into the library; gets a new id)
;     pen                     -> ok <tool settings as JSON> of the open document
;     setpen <JSON>           (apply tool settings from the other tablet; keeps the active tool)
;     setscroll <page> <top>  (notebook pages only: scroll so scene y <top> is at the top of the view)
;     pagestep <n>            (a page turn by hand moves n pages: 2 in book mode; back to 1 when
;                              another document opens or the tablet wakes up)
;     reorder <i0,i1,...> <page>  (move pages so the page at position i_j comes to position j,
;                              pages after the list stay; then open <page>; answered when done)
;     link <usb|wifi|->       (linked to the other tablet over USB / WiFi: show it in the status
;                              tray of the library; "-": hide it, page turns step one page again)
;   answer  -> GET http://127.0.0.1:7781/ev?RESP <nonce> ok ... | error ...
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: dualrmPoller
                objectName: "dualrmPoller"
                property string lastNonce: ""
                property var evQueue: []
                property bool evBusy: false

                // events go out one at a time so the receiver sees them in order
                function ev(msg, done) {
                    evQueue.push({ msg: msg, done: done });
                    if (!evBusy) {
                        evNext();
                    }
                }
                function evNext() {
                    const item = evQueue.shift();
                    if (!item) {
                        evBusy = false;
                        return;
                    }
                    evBusy = true;
                    const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    x.onreadystatechange = () => {
                        if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                            return;
                        }
                        if (item.done) {
                            item.done();
                        }
                        evNext();
                    };
                    x.open("GET", "http://127.0.0.1:7781/ev?" + encodeURIComponent(item.msg));
                    x.send();
                }

                function emitPage() {
                    const d = documentView.item?.document;
                    if (d && !reordering) {
                        ev("PAGE " + String(d.id) + " " + d.pageCount + " " + documentView.item.currentPage);
                    }
                }
                // ---- page order: moves on one tablet are repeated on the other (ORDER / reorder)
                property var pageIdList: []     // page ids of the open document, in order
                property bool reordering: false // applying a reorder: no ORDER / PAGE reports
                property var orderTarget: []
                property string orderWaitId: ""
                property int orderWaitAt: -1
                property int orderTries: 0
                property string orderNonce: ""
                property int orderPage: -1

                function pageIds() {
                    const d = documentView.item?.document;
                    const a = [];
                    if (!d) {
                        return a;
                    }
                    for (let i = 0; i < d.pageCount; i++) {
                        a.push(String(d.idForPage(i)));
                    }
                    return a;
                }
                function pageMapChanged() {
                    const now = pageIds();
                    const old = pageIdList;
                    pageIdList = now;
                    // pages added or removed: the PAGE report covers that
                    if (reordering || now.length !== old.length || now.length < 2) {
                        return;
                    }
                    const pos = {};
                    for (let i = 0; i < old.length; i++) {
                        pos[old[i]] = i;
                    }
                    const perm = [];
                    let moved = false;
                    for (let j = 0; j < now.length; j++) {
                        if (pos[now[j]] === undefined) {
                            return;
                        }
                        perm.push(pos[now[j]]);
                        moved = moved || pos[now[j]] !== j;
                    }
                    if (moved) {
                        ev("ORDER " + String(documentView.item.document.id) + " " + perm.join(","));
                    }
                }
                // move one page; 3.29 takes document ids, 3.23 (which still has
                // Library.createCollectionWrapper) takes the entries
                function movePage(from, to) {
                    const d = documentView.item.document;
                    if (typeof Library.createCollectionWrapper !== "function") {
                        return DocumentController.movePages(d.id, [from], d.id, to, () => {});
                    }
                    const e = Library.entryForId(d.id);
                    return DocumentController.movePages(e, [from], e, to, () => {});
                }
                // Always move the first page that is out of place forward into its place: moving a
                // page towards the front gives the same result whichever way the insert index is
                // counted. Each move is confirmed in the page map before the next one.
                function orderStep() {
                    const cur = pageIds();
                    if (orderWaitId !== "") {
                        if (cur[orderWaitAt] !== orderWaitId) {
                            if (++orderTries > 40) {
                                orderDone("error move-timeout");
                            } else {
                                dualrmOrderTimer.restart();
                            }
                            return;
                        }
                        orderWaitId = "";
                    }
                    let j = 0;
                    while (j < cur.length && j < orderTarget.length && cur[j] === orderTarget[j]) {
                        j++;
                    }
                    if (j >= cur.length || j >= orderTarget.length) {
                        orderDone("ok");
                        return;
                    }
                    const k = cur.indexOf(orderTarget[j]);
                    if (k <= j) {
                        orderDone("error bad-order");
                        return;
                    }
                    orderWaitId = orderTarget[j];
                    orderWaitAt = j;
                    orderTries = 0;
                    if (!movePage(k, j)) {
                        orderDone("error move-refused");
                        return;
                    }
                    dualrmOrderTimer.restart();
                }
                function orderDone(result) {
                    dualrmOrderTimer.stop();
                    orderWaitId = "";
                    pageIdList = pageIds();
                    reordering = false;
                    if (orderPage >= 0 && documentView.item?.document) {
                        documentView.item.openPage(Math.min(orderPage, documentView.item.document.pageCount - 1));
                    }
                    emitPage();
                    respond(orderNonce, result);
                }
                Timer {
                    id: dualrmOrderTimer
                    interval: 150
                    onTriggered: dualrmPoller.orderStep()
                }

                function emitState() {
                    const d = documentView.item?.document;
                    if (!d) {
                        ev("DOC -");
                        return;
                    }
                    ev("DOC " + String(d.id));
                    emitPage();
                }

                Connections {
                    target: documentView.item
                    ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                    function onDocumentChanged() {
                        documentView.item.dualrmPageStep = 1;
                        dualrmPoller.pageIdList = dualrmPoller.pageIds();
                        dualrmPoller.emitState();
                    }
                    // a page added on the way (dualrmPageSettle running) is reported once it settles
                    function onCurrentPageChanged() {
                        if (!dualrmPageSettle.running) {
                            dualrmPoller.emitPage();
                        }
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: documentView.item?.document ?? null
                    ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                    function onPageCountChanged() {
                        dualrmPageSettle.tries = 0;
                        dualrmPageSettle.restart();
                    }
                    function onPageMapChanged() { dualrmPoller.pageMapChanged(); }
                }
                // Adding a page changes the count first and opens the new page later (DocumentView's
                // addPage callback, addingPage = true until then). One PAGE report with both, so the
                // sync sees the current page = where the page was inserted, not the page before it.
                Timer {
                    id: dualrmPageSettle
                    property int tries: 0
                    interval: 250
                    onTriggered: {
                        if (documentView.item?.addingPage && tries < 20) {
                            tries++;
                            restart();
                            return;
                        }
                        dualrmPoller.emitPage();
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: documentView.item
                    ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                    function onDualrmPenChanged() {
                        if (documentView.item?.document) {
                            dualrmPoller.ev("PEN " + documentView.item.dualrmPenState());
                        }
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: documentView.item
                    ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                    function onDualrmScrollChanged() {
                        const d = documentView.item?.document;
                        if (d) {
                            dualrmPoller.ev("SCROLL " + String(d.id) + " " + documentView.item.dualrmScrollPage
                                    + " " + Math.round(documentView.item.dualrmScrollTop));
                        }
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: BatteryManager
                    ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                    function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
                        if (previous === BatteryManager.Normal && next !== BatteryManager.Normal) {
                            dualrmPoller.ev("SLEEP");
                        } else if (previous !== BatteryManager.Normal && next === BatteryManager.Normal) {
                            if (documentView.item) {
                                documentView.item.dualrmPageStep = 1;   // alone until the sync says otherwise
                            }
                            dualrmPoller.ev("WAKE");
                        }
                    }
                }

                // long-poll for the next command; dualrm-cmd.sh holds the request until there is one
                function poll() {
                    const x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    x.onreadystatechange = () => {
                        if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                            return;
                        }
                        const line = (x.responseText || "").trim();
                        if (x.status !== 200) {
                            dualrmRetry.interval = 3000;     // socket not up yet
                            dualrmRetry.start();
                            return;
                        }
                        if (line === "") {
                            dualrmRetry.interval = 50;
                            dualrmRetry.start();
                            return;
                        }
                        const nonce = line.split(" ")[0];
                        if (nonce === lastNonce) {
                            // answered before but the answer was lost: answer again so it is cleared
                            ev("RESP " + nonce + " " + lastAnswer, () => dualrmPoller.poll());
                            return;
                        }
                        lastNonce = nonce;
                        handle(line);
                    };
                    x.open("GET", "http://127.0.0.1:7782/next");
                    x.send();
                }
                property string lastAnswer: ""
                Timer {
                    id: dualrmRetry
                    repeat: false
                    onTriggered: dualrmPoller.poll()
                }
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    poll();
                    emitState();
                }

                function respond(nonce, text) {
                    console.log("[dualrm] " + nonce + " " + text);
                    lastAnswer = text;
                    ev("RESP " + nonce + " " + text, () => dualrmPoller.poll());
                }

                function handle(line) {
                    const parts = line.split(" ");
                    const nonce = parts[0];
                    const cmd = parts[1];
                    try {
                        if (cmd === "open") {
                            const entry = Library.entryForId(parts[2]);
                            if (!entry) {
                                respond(nonce, "error unknown-entry " + parts[2]);
                                return;
                            }
                            root.openDocument_helper(entry, () => documentView.item.openDocument(entry));
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + entry.id);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "close") {
                            const open = documentView.item?.document;
                            if (open && (parts.length < 3 || parts[2] === "-" || parts[2] === String(open.id))) {
                                documentView.item.close();
                                respond(nonce, "ok closed " + open.id);
                            } else {
                                respond(nonce, "ok nothing-to-close");
                            }
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "emit") {
                            emitState();
                            respond(nonce, "ok");
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "status") {
                            const open = documentView.item?.document;
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + (open ? String(open.id) : "-") + " " + (open ? open.pageCount : 0)
                                    + " " + (open ? documentView.item.currentPage : -1));
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "addpage") {
                            const open = documentView.item?.document;
                            if (!open) {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-document");
                                return;
                            }
                            const idx = parts.length > 2 ? parseInt(parts[2]) : undefined;
                            documentView.item.addPage(open, idx);
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + open.pageCount);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "ensure") {
                            // ensure <count> <targetPage>: append blank pages in one batch, then open target
                            if (!documentView.item?.document) {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-document");
                                return;
                            }
                            const total = documentView.item.dualrmEnsurePages(parseInt(parts[2]), parseInt(parts[3]));
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + total);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "gotopage") {
                            if (!documentView.item?.document) {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-document");
                                return;
                            }
                            documentView.item.openPage(parseInt(parts[2]));
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + parts[2]);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "mkdir" || cmd === "create") {
                            const parent = parts[2] === "-" ? "" : parts[2];
                            const name = parts.slice(3).join(" ");
                            if (name === "") {
                                respond(nonce, "error empty-name");
                                return;
                            }
                            // 3.29 dropped Library.createCollectionWrapper for LibraryController.createCollection
                            const id = cmd !== "mkdir"
                                ? LibraryController.createDocument(parent, name)
                                : typeof Library.createCollectionWrapper === "function"
                                    ? Library.createCollectionWrapper(parent, name)
                                    : LibraryController.createCollection(parent, name);
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + String(id));
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "pen" || cmd === "setpen") {
                            if (!documentView.item?.document) {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-document");
                                return;
                            }
                            if (cmd === "setpen") {
                                documentView.item.dualrmSetPen(parts.slice(2).join(" "));
                            }
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + documentView.item.dualrmPenState());
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "setscroll") {
                            if (!documentView.item?.document) {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-document");
                                return;
                            }
                            respond(nonce, documentView.item.dualrmSetScroll(parseInt(parts[2]), parseFloat(parts[3])));
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "pagestep") {
                            if (!documentView.item) {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-document-view");
                                return;
                            }
                            documentView.item.dualrmPageStep = Math.max(1, parseInt(parts[2]) || 1);
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + documentView.item.dualrmPageStep);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "reorder") {
                            const open = documentView.item?.document;
                            if (!open) {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-document");
                                return;
                            }
                            if (reordering) {
                                respond(nonce, "error busy");
                                return;
                            }
                            const perm = (parts[2] || "").split(",").map(Number);
                            const cur = pageIds();
                            if (perm.length < 2 || perm.length > cur.length
                                    || perm.some(i => !(i >= 0 && i < perm.length))) {
                                respond(nonce, "error bad-order " + perm.length + "/" + cur.length);
                                return;
                            }
                            orderTarget = perm.map(i => cur[i]).concat(cur.slice(perm.length));
                            orderNonce = nonce;
                            orderPage = parts.length > 3 ? parseInt(parts[3]) : -1;
                            orderWaitId = "";
                            reordering = true;
                            orderStep();     // answers when the order is in place
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "link") {
                            const via = parts[2] || "-";
                            dualrmLink.via = via === "-" ? "" : via;
                            if (via === "-" && documentView.item) {
                                documentView.item.dualrmPageStep = 1;   // alone again
                            }
                            respond(nonce, "ok " + via);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cmd === "import") {
                            if (typeof DocumentImporter === "undefined") {
                                respond(nonce, "error no-importer");
                                return;
                            }
                            const parent = parts[2] === "-" ? "" : parts[2];
                            const file = parts.slice(3).join(" ");
                            DocumentImporter.importFromUrls(["file://" + file.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/")], parent);
                            respond(nonce, "ok");
                            return;
                        }
                        respond(nonce, "error unknown-command " + cmd);
                    } catch (e) {
                        respond(nonce, "error exception " + e);
                    }
                }

            }

            // link state ("usb" / "wifi" / "" when not linked), set by the "link" command; the
            // status tray in ContentHeader (patched below) finds this item by its objectName
            Item {
                id: dualrmLink
                objectName: "dualrmLink"
                property string via: ""
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Batched page append, pen settings, notebook scrolling and book-mode page turns inside DocumentView (DocumentController, DeviceScreenInfo
; and the DocumentToolSettings documentViewTools are in scope there).
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            // pen, colour and width changes, reported once they settle; not the ones dualrmSetPen makes.
            // Unqualified names: the root id is "documentView" on 3.23 and "root" on 3.29.
            signal dualrmPenChanged()
            property bool dualrmPenQuiet: false
            Timer {
                id: dualrmPenSettle
                interval: 400
                onTriggered: {
                    if (!dualrmPenQuiet) {
                        dualrmPenChanged();
                    }
                }
            }
            Timer {
                id: dualrmPenQuietEnd
                interval: 1000
                onTriggered: dualrmPenQuiet = false
            }
            Connections {
                target: documentViewTools.primaryPen
                ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                function onPropertyChanged() { dualrmPenSettle.restart(); }
            }
            Connections {
                target: documentViewTools.secondaryPen
                ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                function onPropertyChanged() { dualrmPenSettle.restart(); }
            }
            Connections {
                target: documentViewTools.eraserPen
                ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                function onPropertyChanged() { dualrmPenSettle.restart(); }
            }
            function dualrmPenState() {
                return JSON.stringify(documentViewTools.toolSettings());
            }
            function dualrmSetPen(json) {
                const settings = JSON.parse(json);
                delete settings.LastActiveTool;      // which pen is in hand stays per tablet
                dualrmPenQuiet = true;
                documentViewTools.setToolSettings(settings);
                dualrmPenQuietEnd.restart();
            }

            // Notebook scroll position: the scene y at the top of the view, reported once it settles.
            // A position set by dualrmSetScroll is not reported back. Opening a page restores the
            // page's own saved position once its tiles are ready, so for 3 s a position that was set
            // is applied again whenever the view settles somewhere else.
            signal dualrmScrollChanged()
            property real dualrmScrollTop: NaN       // last reported or applied top
            property int dualrmScrollPage: -1
            property var dualrmScrollWant: null      // { page, top, until }: re-apply once at settle
            Timer {
                id: dualrmScrollSettle
                interval: 400
                onTriggered: {
                    const t = dualrmScrollNow();
                    if (isNaN(t)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    // until it expires, a position from the other tablet wins over a late restore
                    const w = dualrmScrollWant;
                    if (w && (w.page !== currentPage || Date.now() >= w.until)) {
                        dualrmScrollWant = null;
                    } else if (w && Math.abs(t - w.top) >= 2) {
                        dualrmScrollMove(w.top);
                        return;
                    }
                    if (currentPage === dualrmScrollPage && Math.abs(t - dualrmScrollTop) < 2) {
                        return;
                    }
                    dualrmScrollTop = t;
                    dualrmScrollPage = currentPage;
                    dualrmScrollChanged();
                }
            }
            Connections {
                target: sceneView.tileManager
                ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                function onTransformChanged() {
                    if (notePage) {
                        dualrmScrollSettle.restart();
                    }
                }
            }
            Connections {
                target: sceneView
                ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                function onPageChanged() { dualrmScrollSettle.restart(); }
                function onTileManagerChanged() { dualrmScrollSettle.restart(); }
            }
            function dualrmScrollNow() {
                const tm = sceneView.tileManager;
                if (!document || !notePage || !tm) {
                    return NaN;
                }
                return tm.viewToScene(Qt.point(0, 0)).y;
            }
            function dualrmScrollMove(top) {
                const tm = sceneView.tileManager;
                const cur = tm.viewToScene(Qt.point(0, 0)).y;
                dualrmScrollTop = top;
                dualrmScrollPage = currentPage;
                if (Math.abs(top - cur) >= 1) {
                    tm.moveViewBy(Qt.point(0, (cur - top) * tm.scale));   // negative y scrolls down
                    sceneView.scrollPositionChanged = true;               // remembered for this page
                }
                return cur;
            }
            function dualrmSetScroll(page, top) {
                if (isNaN(dualrmScrollNow())) {
                    return "error not-a-notebook-page";
                }
                if (currentPage !== page) {
                    return "error on-page " + currentPage;
                }
                dualrmScrollWant = { page: page, top: top, until: Date.now() + 3000 };
                return "ok " + Math.round(dualrmScrollMove(top));
            }

            // Page turns by hand (swipe, page keys) go through moveForward / moveBackward. In book
            // mode each tablet shows every other page, so a turn moves dualrmPageStep pages at once
            // (one screen refresh, not a turn plus a correction by the sync). Clamped to the
            // document; always at least one page, like the stock turn. The REBUILDs below match
            // "currentPage" alone: it is "root.currentPage" on 3.29, "documentView.currentPage" on 3.23.
            property int dualrmPageStep: 1
            function dualrmPageDelta(dir) {
                const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentPage + dir * dualrmPageStep, document.pageCount - 1));
                return Math.max(1, Math.abs(t - currentPage));
            }

            function dualrmEnsurePages(count, target) {
                const doc = documentView.document;
                if (!doc) {
                    return -1;
                }
                const have = doc.pageCount;
                const n = Math.min(count - have, 500);
                if (n <= 0) {
                    if (target >= 0) {
                        documentView.openPage(Math.min(target, have - 1));
                    }
                    return have;
                }
                const template = doc.templateForPage(have - 1);
                const paperSize = DeviceScreenInfo.paperSize;
                documentView.addingPage = true;
                for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
                    DocumentController.addPageWithTemplateAndPageSize(doc, -1, template, paperSize);
                }
                DocumentController.addPageWithTemplateAndPageSize(doc, -1, template, paperSize, function() {
                    documentView.addingPage = false;
                    if (target >= 0) {
                        documentView.openPage(Math.min(target, have + n - 1));
                    }
                });
                return have + n;
            }
        }
        REBUILD moveForward
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            REPLACE { currentPage + 1 } WITH { currentPage + dualrmPageDelta(1) }
        END REBUILD
        REBUILD moveBackward
            LOCATE BEFORE ALL
            REPLACE { currentPage - 1 } WITH { currentPage - dualrmPageDelta(-1) }
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
